# About Me

Hi, I'm Erik De Luca. I am a freelance biostatistician, actuary, and Data Scientist.

My professional journey is built on a strong background in statistics and actuarial techniques. While my roots lie in highly complex sectors like public health analytics, insurance motor pricing, and quantitative finance, today I partner primarily with Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) across diverse industries. Operating as an end-to-end, solo consultant, I provide agile solutions—meaning I personally take charge of your data challenges from the initial analysis to the final, ready-to-use product, with zero corporate bottlenecks.

Extracting insights, however, is only half the equation. Driven by a deep passion for IT and software engineering, I bridge the gap between pure statistics and modern data infrastructure. I specialize in managing large-scale data environments—having comfortably handled databases exceeding 200GB and 20 million records—and automating tedious workflows into beautiful, seamless pipelines. In past projects, I have successfully engineered data solutions that reduced week-long manual procedures down to just 20 minutes of automated processing.

My technical stack includes Python, R, SQL, and Docker, allowing me to design and deploy scalable architectures both on-premise and in cloud environments. To guarantee that every project is secure, maintainable, and production-ready, I integrate strict IT best practices into my daily workflow, including version control with Git and GitHub, automated testing, and structured releases.

Beyond technical execution, I bring a strong entrepreneurial mindset to my projects. Having actively participated in several startup competitions, I am trained to look beyond the code and align technical solutions directly with concrete business goals and real market needs. 

When I’m not immersed in code, models, and numbers, I love to disconnect by indulging in travel, craft beer brewing, and practicing judo. 

Whether you need advanced statistical modeling, a robust data pipeline, or a dedicated technical partner to solve your business bottlenecks, I'm here to help you get the most out of your data. Let's build something great together!
